subject: Fasting Restores Young Chromatin Architecture in Animal Brains
script: From Agewell Brief: Fasting Restores Young Chromatin Architecture in Animal Brains. A systematic review shows how caloric restriction resets histone tags and DNA methylation in rodent neurons, revealing how metabolic signals physically alter genetic memory. As brain cells age, the physical packaging of their genetic material unravels. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
